(d) in case, the number of seats required to be
reserved for women from amongst the seats not
reserved under sub-section (1), (2) and (2A)
of section 17 to match the one-half of the total
number of seats, are not attained in accordance
with the roster for any term of election, the
procedure stated under provisos to clause (b)
and (c) of sub-rule (2) shall be followed.
(e) in case the number of constituency determined
under sub-section (3) and (4) of section 17 is
one only, that constituency shall be reserved for
women for the first term of election and there
shall be no reservation for the second term of
